rows.en: Come on, come on, don't be shy!
rows.notes: Male ending frd_myk_009; the player coaxes Miyuki into serving.

rows.en: Hey, cut it out...
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki, both endings (casual speech here).

rows.en:
You wanted to try opening a cafe, didn't you,
Miyuki?
rows.notes: x2, player, both endings. kissaten, hajimete mitakatta read as 'wanted to try starting a cafe'; the male player calls her Miyuki here as the Japanese does.

rows.en:
Then go ahead and pour it just like that.
And don't forget to smile!
Just one 'yeah' will do!
rows.notes: x2, player, both endings; scolds her doubled 'Yeah, yeah.' (c03244, henji wa ikkai).

rows.en: Allow me to pour your tea, Master!
Yep, nicely done!
Is the tea good?
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki to the player, both endings.

rows.en:
Yeah, it's 50% better thanks to your smile,
Miyuki.
Isn't there more to it than that?
It's 100% better, because it's packed with love!

Shirakawa ending (male).
Slot filler for female.
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (frd_myk_009 female branch, frd_myk_090); translated literally as for the Luca/Yamashiro endings.

rows.en:
Shirakawa ending (female).
Slot filler for male.
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (frd_myk_010 male branch); translated literally.

rows.en: Come on, come on, don't be shy now!
Allow me to pour your tea, milady!
Mm-hm, nicely done!

Mm-hm, your smile makes it 50% better,
Miyuki.

It's 100% better, because it's packed
with friendship!
rows.notes: Female (yuujou instead of the male version's aijou).

rows.en: Shirakawa ending (male).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (frd_myk_090); translated literally.

rows.en: (Today I'm seeing a movie with Shirakawa!)

Sorry to keep you waiting,
\p-kun.
rows.notes: x7, Miyuki greeting the male player (frd_myk_101/104/106/113/115); matches c09417 (-san version).

rows.en:
Oh, I see.
Well then, shall we go?
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki, both genders; answers 'I just got here myself'.

rows.en:
That was a good movie.
I never saw where the second half was going...
It caught me off guard, in a good way.

All the foreshadowing was carefully laid out,
so I bet it'd feel different on a second watch...
Oh, it's getting late, so I'll head home now.
Please invite me again.
(Today I came to see a movie with Miyuki.)
(Today I'm seeing a movie with Shirakawa again!)

I'm sorry to keep you waiting,
\p-kun.
I just got here myself, so don't worry.

Oh, I see...
Shall we go, then?
That was another good movie.

A classic formula, I guess you'd call it.
It was easy to follow, and I could just sit
back and enjoy it.
rows.notes: x2, player, both genders (oudou = the classic, by-the-book story).

rows.en:
It didn't try anything gimmicky,
but it never got boring, did it?
(Today I came to see a movie with Miyuki again.)

I'm sorry to keep you waiting,
\p-san.
I just got here myself, so don't worry.
(Today I came to Folmo with Shirakawa!)
What a big town this is.
rows.notes: x2, Miyuki. Folmo is called a machi (town) here.

rows.en: Yeah, it's a Zentradi town, after all...
Why don't we look around a little?

Before that, let's get some ice cream.
The ice cream here's got a great reputation.
I could eat these all day, huh.
Yes, it's delicious!

Just as I thought, you like sweets too,
Shirakawa.
There isn't a girl alive who hates sweets.
Well then, let's walk around a bit.
(Today I came to Folmo with Miyuki.)
Yeah, it's a Zentradi town, after all~

Before that, let's get some ice cream.
The ice cream here's got a great reputation!
I could eat these all day, right...?

Just as I thought, you've got a weakness
for sweets too, Miyuki.
(Today I came to Folmo with Shirakawa again!)
No matter how often I see it, it's such a big town.
Yeah, it looks like it's got plenty to explore.
Let's grab some ice cream before that.
I could eat these all day, right?
Yes, it's delicious.
You've got a real sweet tooth too, Shirakawa!

I-It's not like I'll eat anything as long as
it's sweet, you know?
...Let's walk around a bit!
(Today I came to Folmo with Miyuki again.)

Yeah, but that makes it all the more fun
to explore.
rows.notes: Female (sono bun tanken shigai ga aru).

rows.en: Before that, let's get some ice cream.
Haah... I could eat these all day, right?

uncertain: c11026: 'kissaten, hajimete mitakatta' read as Miyuki wanting to try opening (starting) a cafe; it could also mean trying out cafe work. Rendered 'You wanted to try opening a cafe, didn't you, Miyuki?'.
c11035, c11036, c11042: developer placeholder lines under Alto's name plate (Shirakawa ending / slot filler), translated literally as for the Luca and Yamashiro endings.
c11038: ojou-sama in the maid-cafe roleplay rendered 'milady' (goshujin-sama in the male version = 'Master').
